item.title: Room-temperature continuous-wave lasing-like emission from solution-processed bulk monolayer MoS<sub>2</sub> thin films
item.content:encoded:
Nature Communications, Published online: 13 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79012-8

Scaling up atomically thin light emitters remains challenging. Here, authors develop solution-processable bulk-monolayer MoS2 films that preserve monolayer optical properties and exhibit room-temperature lasing-like emission under continuous optical pumping at just a few nW.
item.dc:title: Room-temperature continuous-wave lasing-like emission from solution-processed bulk monolayer MoS<sub>2</sub> thin films

item.title: Signatures of a Kondo insulator in a multilayer moiré Superlattice
item.content:encoded:
Nature Communications, Published online: 13 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-78687-3

Kondo insulator phases are traditionally found in materials with f-electrons. Here, the authors present evidence towards the realization of a tunable Kondo insulator in a monolayer WS2/bilayer WSe2 moiré superlattice.
item.dc:title: Signatures of a Kondo insulator in a multilayer moiré Superlattice

item.title: Anion manipulation for breaking through 3.0 V of aluminium–graphite batteries
item.content:encoded:
Nature Communications, Published online: 13 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79156-7

Aluminium–graphite batteries are limited by electrolyte decomposition above 2.5 V. Here, authors regulate chloroaluminate anions with a fluorine-rich, framework-confined quasi-solid-state electrolyte, enabling stable 3.0 V operation for Al | |Graphite cells.
item.dc:title: Anion manipulation for breaking through 3.0 V of aluminium–graphite batteries

item.title: Scaling medical imaging report generation with multimodal reinforcement learning
item.content:encoded:
Nature Communications, Published online: 12 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-78767-4

Researchers developed UniRG, a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes clinically aligned composite rewards for medical imaging report generation. UniRG outperforms prior models and demonstrates strong generalization across unseen hospitals and datasets
item.dc:title: Scaling medical imaging report generation with multimodal reinforcement learning

item.title: A single NLS directs AGO1 import shaping small RNA loading and silencing outputs in Arabidopsis
item.content:encoded:
Nature Communications, Published online: 12 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79175-4

Small RNAs guide ARGONAUTE proteins to their targets. Here the authors identify a pathway controlling AGO1 nuclear import and show that AGO1 subcellular localization shapes small RNA loading and silencing outputs in plants.
item.dc:title: A single NLS directs AGO1 import shaping small RNA loading and silencing outputs in Arabidopsis

item.title: Thin-film lithium niobate waveguide-integrated p-i-n Tungsten selenide photodiodes with 10Gbit/s data reception
item.content:encoded:
Nature Communications, Published online: 12 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79595-2

Thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) is a promising photonic platform, but its integration with 2D materials remains challenging. Here, the authors report the realization of TFLN-based waveguide-integrated WSe2 photodetectors, showing a 3-dB bandwidth up to 1.12 GHz, up to 10 Gbit/s data rates and responsivity up to 492 mA/W in the visible range.
item.dc:title: Thin-film lithium niobate waveguide-integrated p-i-n Tungsten selenide photodiodes with 10Gbit/s data reception
